paper_title: First results of axion dark matter search with DANCE
notes: DANCE Act-1 optical bow-tie cavity, polarization-based axion DM search without magnetic field. Reports 95% CL upper limit g_agamma <= 8e-4 GeV^-1 in mass range 1e-14 to 1e-13 eV. Numerical limit only stated in text/abstract; the detailed exclusion curve is in Fig. 6 but values are not tabulated. The two data points represent the quoted flat bound across the stated mass range.
